netlify-blobs.description: Guide for using Netlify Blobs object storage. Use when storing files, images, documents, or simple key-value data without a full database. Covers getStore(), CRUD operations, metadata, listing, deploy-scoped vs site-scoped stores, and local development.

netlify-caching.description: Guide for controlling caching on Netlify's CDN. netlify-cli-and-deploy.description: Guide for using the Netlify CLI and deploying sites. netlify-config.description: Reference for netlify.toml configuration. netlify-deploy.description: Deploy projects to Netlify with the Netlify CLI. Use when the user wants to link a repo, validate deploy settings, run a deploy, or choose between preview and production flows.

netlify-edge-functions.description: Guide for writing Netlify Edge Functions. netlify-forms.description: Guide for using Netlify Forms for HTML form handling. Use when adding contact forms, feedback forms, file upload forms, or any form that should be collected by Netlify. netlify-frameworks.description: Guide for deploying web frameworks on Netlify. netlify-functions.description: Guide for writing Netlify serverless functions.
